availability.note: These five are one room's slots. The shop sells thirteen rooms at overlapping times, so a check that ignores the room will call a closer slot in another room a miss when it is a better answer.

price.note: Their widget showed 'Booking Subtotal $82.00' for its default party size; the page did not show the per-head split, so it is not recorded as one. Their API reports $37.00 a player pre-tax for this room, and 2 x $37 is $74, so the $8 difference is tax or a fee we have not yet identified. Do not reconcile this by guessing.
